evidence.title: Crypto.com Visa Card — EEA product page (tier table, FAQ, disclaimers)
evidence.excerpt: Tier table: Midnight Blue free / 0% everyday; Ruby Steel €3.99/mo or €39.90/yr or €450 lock-up, 1.5% up to USD 750/mo; Jade/Indigo €24.99/mo or €249.90/yr or €4,500 lock-up, 2.5% up to USD 1,500; Icy/Rose Gold €45,000 lock-up 3.5% up to USD 3,000 then 0.5%; Obsidian €450,000 lock-up 4.5% up to USD 5,000 then 1%. Free ATM €200/€400/€800/€800/€1,000. Issuer Foris MT Limited. Prepaid card.
evidence.contradiction_note: Page says 'Visa' in title/footer but 'Prepaid Mastercard Card' in FAQ answers; meta claims zero FX fees while body says fees may apply. Record keeps Visa (issuer licence statement) and FX = unknown.

changelog.reason: Initial record from the EEA product page (single read). Help Centre fee articles not reachable; FX, top-up and ATM-overage fees remain unknown. Eligible country list missing.

Second independent read on 2026-10-29 of https://crypto.com/eea/cards/: every value the page sources is confirmed — tier prices (free / €3.99 or €39.90/yr or €450 lock / €24.99 or €249.90/yr or €4,500 lock / €45,000 lock / €450,000 lock, 12 months), everyday CRO rewards 0/1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5% with caps USD 750/1,500/3,000/5,000 and post-cap 0.5%/1%, travel rewards up to 5/20/25/30/40%, free ATM €200/400/800/800/1,000 per month, ATM limit €10,000/month, top-up limit €25,000/month, issuer Foris MT Limited (Visa Principal Member, MFSA e-money licence), prepaid, Apply Now live. Still no eligible-country list and no KYC detail on the page; Visa/Mastercard and FX-fee contradictions unchanged and already modelled conservatively (FX unknown). Not modelled (omission, not a contradiction): permanent streaming rebates and lounge access on the €45,000 and €450,000 tiers. NOT published: the validator refuses a published variant whose eligibility is unknown (no country list on any official page read) and whose KYC is a hypothesis (page states only that Level Up membership is required). Record stays validated until an official eligibility list and KYC article are read; no value changed.

editorial.summary: Prepaid Visa issued by Foris MT (Malta) for the EEA. The free tier earns no everyday rewards; paid tiers from €3.99/month earn 1.5–4.5% in CRO with monthly USD caps, or require 12-month CRO lock-ups from €450 to €450,000.
good_for: People who accept a monthly fee or a 12-month CRO lock-up in exchange for CRO rewards
Streaming-subscription rebates on Ruby and above
not_for: Anyone who wants rewards without a fee or token lock (free tier earns 0% everyday)
Anyone who needs certainty on FX, top-up and ATM-overage fees before choosing (not stated on the page)
watch_outs: Rewards and lock-ups are in CRO; their value moves with the token price. No appreciation is assumed anywhere on this site.
Caps are stated in USD while pricing is in EUR.
Eligibility: the page gives no country list; confirm with the provider.
The page contradicts itself on the card network (Visa vs Mastercard) and on FX fees.
